content3.content: Architecture in app development is like the blueprint of a house. It tells you where each room (feature) is, how you walk between rooms (navigation), and what each room is responsible for (logic).

content4.content:
Code becomes messy 💩
Hard to fix bugs 🐞
Difficult to scale 🏗️

content8.content:
UI (Widgets): What you see — like furniture and walls.
Business Logic: The brain — like knowing when to turn lights on/off.
Data Layer: Like the storage room — where info is kept (e.g., database, APIs).
Controller/Mediator: Like the housekeeper — keeps everything coordinated.

content11.content:
MVC (Model-View-Controller) – Simple apps.
MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) – Better for logic separation.
BLoC (Business Logic Component) – Powerful, scalable.
Provider – Recommended for state management by Flutter team.

content12.content: We'll go with Provider Architecture as it’s:

content35.content:
🗂️ Maintain clean folder structure
🧠 Separate UI from logic
📦 Use ChangeNotifier for small to medium apps
🚫 Don’t use setState inside Provider-based architecture
🧪 Use unit tests for logic (not mandatory for beginners, but good to know)

content38.content: ✅ Provider = Easiest way to manage app state

content40.content:
Model = Data
Provider = Logic
Screen = UI
